coverageNotes: Both official district sample ballots and all 70 certified candidate choices were compared. The St. Croix sample has 6 contests and 42 choices; St. Thomas/St. John has 7 contests and 37 choices. Every governor running mate is preserved as an explicit joint ticket. No ballot question appears on either captured two-page sample.

provenance.sourceOrg: Election System of the Virgin Islands
provenance.quote: The official St. Croix district sample prints the district Legislature and board of education races on the same ballot.

provenance.sourceOrg: Election System of the Virgin Islands
provenance.quote: The Board consists of fourteen members; seven from each district, who are elected by the electors of each election district beginning with the 2018 general election. The official St. Croix district sample prints the district Legislature and board of elections races on the same ballot.

provenance.sourceOrg: Election System of the Virgin Islands
provenance.quote: The official St. Thomas/St. John district sample prints the district Legislature and board of education races on the same ballot.

provenance.sourceOrg: Election System of the Virgin Islands
provenance.quote: The Board consists of fourteen members; seven from each district, who are elected by the electors of each election district beginning with the 2018 general election. The official St. Thomas/St. John district sample prints the district Legislature and board of elections races on the same ballot. Both STJ and STT seat groups are printed together on the combined district ballot.
